scope: An explicit builtin pg_catalog.C collation on a PostgreSQL text projection. Preserve native ordering and duplicate handling of the containing SELECT.

Expression/CollatedText.role: A native text result expression with one explicit resolved collation.
Expression/CollatedText.structure: One immutable text literal, native text field or NULL operand, plus a closed builtin collation identity.
Expression/CollatedText.conditions: A reference belongs to a visible scoped text slot. Lower the explicitly qualified pg_catalog.C spelling with a checked text or NULL operand. A nested different collation or another scalar type is outside this role.
Expression/CollatedText.meaning: Preserve the exact decoded text or NULL and carry the explicit deterministic byte order. The containing SELECT uses that order for positional ordering and text equality under DISTINCT.
Expression/CollatedText.sql: Group the operand and collate it with pg_catalog.C, quoted as an identifier. Type the NULL operand explicitly as pg_catalog.text.

Expression/TextCollation.role: A builtin native PostgreSQL collation identity.
Expression/TextCollation.structure: The closed string enum has one C case in this revision.
Expression/TextCollation.conditions: The catalog name is pg_catalog.C. The selected database encoding is UTF-8 and the builtin is deterministic.
Expression/TextCollation.meaning: Compare UTF-8 bytes and use deterministic equality of complete byte sequences.
Expression/TextCollation.sql: Emit pg_catalog followed by the double-quoted exact collation identifier.

externalInterpretation: The same declared native text fields and rows are visible. The builtin C collation has the stock deterministic identity. The pinned test database has an en_US.utf8 default so an omitted collation changes the observed order.
observations: Exact ordered result labels and text metadata
Preserve original bytes, NULL, repeated rows and semantically guaranteed order
Observe native collation at every projected position, including duplicate labels and a statement returning no rows
Observe DISTINCT with equal values and with unique values that differ in case or Unicode normalization
Same-collation UNION ALL retains text and the duplicate policy

finite.completeness: Recover actual operand roles, exact C identity, direction, NULL placement and duplicate policy from each constructed graph.

exploration.requiredForms: Vary literals, fields and null operands, result width, order direction, nullable keys, source presence and repeated values.

analysis: Apply the exact qualified builtin collation to untyped text
Apply the exact qualified builtin collation to a scoped text field
Apply it to a text-typed NULL
Compose it with DISTINCT and explicit positional order
additionalControls: Check both collations of duplicate labels in a SELECT with LIMIT 0.
Reject a change confined to the second native collation when rows, names, order and types agree.
negative: A text operand references a signed physical slot
A text operand references an absent occurrence
A collation has another catalog identity
A qualified builtin collation is applied to a signed expression
faults: Reverse the selected positional order direction
Omit the collation of the second output while keeping both values and duplicate result labels

evidence.P02: Enforce the closed operand types and owning SELECT scope.

evidence.P04: Compose with ordered projection, duplicate policy and same-collation UNION ALL.

evidence.P06: Compare DB-native collations, typed ordered values and duplicates.

evidence.Q02: Require the complete finite projection product and seeded roles.
evidence.Q03: Verify exactly how the SELECT structure chooses typed values and order.
evidence.Q04: Use an independent UTF-8 byte comparator and the native engine's measured collation and result.
evidence.Q05: Pin the candidate, verifier, fixture and exact enrolled release receipts.
